info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Heatmap Session Recording…
info.description: Exposes the Heatmap & Session Recording API endpoints for managing configurations and retrieving recorded activity. Heatmap coordinates use relative values: X and Y positions range from 0 to 2000, where 1000 represents 50% of the matched element. Scroll reach and above-the-fold positions range from 0 to 1000, where 100 represents 10% of the page height. idSiteHsr identifies a heatmap or session recording configuration, while idLogHsr identifies an individual recorded activity entry.

The percentage of matching traffic to record, from 0 to 100 with up to one decimal place.
Comma-separated CSS selectors to exclude from the heatmap output.
URL of the page to capture for the heatmap screenshot.
Width threshold used to classify visits as mobile when device detection is unavailable.
Width threshold used to classify visits as tablet when device detection is unavailable.
Whether the DOM should be captured manually instead of automatically.
Optional description providing additional context, such as the purpose or usage.
Whether Matomo should automatically create a new heatmap once this one finishes.
